q: Input-to-state stability (ISS) of ẋ = f(x,u) can be characterized by the existence of an ISS-Lyapunov function V satisfying:
opts: V̇ ≤ −α(|x|) whenever |u| ≤ σ(|x|) for some class K functions α, σ
α₁(|x|) ≤ V(x) ≤ α₂(|x|) and V̇ ≤ −α(|x|) + γ(|u|) for class K∞ functions α₁,α₂,α and class K function γ
exp: ISS Lyapunov function: (1) α₁(|x|) ≤ V ≤ α₂(|x|) (positive definite, radially unbounded), (2) V̇ ≤ −α(|x|) + γ(|u|). Condition (2) means: if |x| is large relative to |u| (|x| ≥ σ(|u|)), then V̇ ≤ −α'(|x|) < 0. The Sontag-Teel theorem: ISS ↔ existence of smooth ISS-Lyapunov function.
